<description>
ConnMan and the HTTP server would still try to read (and send) when a wait reports ErrorEvent. This means they could still read even when a read was not requested.

On select() based platform (BSDs, macOS and Windows), ErrorEvent can be returned if a peer sends us urgent data (we register the exception set because of a Windows quirk). However we can't read that urgent data, and this means we could be continuously woken up.

There is a number of things we could do to improve the situation here (see discussions in #36761), but in the meantime fix this bug by simply disconnecting immediately upon error. For consistency, adopt the same behaviour across all callers.

This PR is an alternative to #36716.
</description>
